Futures (=F) are Yahoo's front-month continuous series; a contract roll can show as an artificial 1-day jump. ^TNX is the 10y yield in % points (chg is % change of the yield).

Peer median uses curated peers when there are any, else same-SIC peers. SIC peers come from EDGAR's company browse by SIC (largest listed first, max 8); they're a best-effort industry read, not hand-picked comparables.
sympathy_flag: solo_move = ticker 5d move >2x its peer median and >=3%; missed_peer_move = peer median beyond +-5% over 5d while the ticker did under half of it or went the other way.
